properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: rsa@0.4.0 is a transitive dependency of the Solana/anchor client stack in Cargo.lock (helium-lib pulls solana-sdk/anchor-client). No `rsa::` or `use rsa` anywhere in workspace code (grep: 0 matches) — the primitives ship in the binary without a first-party call site; reachable via dependencies this tree has not read. Changeable only upstream (Solana stack), observable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Key-type surface of the wallet: `helium-wallet create keypair --type` accepts secp256k1 (ECDSA over the k256 crate via external helium-crypto), ed25519 (default, ed25519-dalek) and ecc_compact (NIST P-256 compressed via p256). The same line is also a site of shard-1's Ed25519 object ALG-5e08bdf5. secp256k1 keys are Shor-vulnerable on a deadline (forgery) rather than harvest basis; generation flows to Keypair::generate at create.rs:154 (ALG-80605930). Changeable here (bounded by blockchain protoc

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: k256 provides the secp256k1 ECDSA implementation behind the external helium-crypto crate's KeyType::Secp256k1, selectable at helium-wallet/src/cmd/create.rs:78 (ALG-673c8f24). Shor-vulnerable signature scheme, deadline risk. Implementation lives outside this tree (helium-crypto); replaceable only upstream, observable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: ed25519-dalek 1.x is the Ed25519 backend of the external helium-crypto crate (and the Solana stack), backing every signature operation in this workspace (wallet keypairs, API request signing, proto message signing). Shor-vulnerable (deadline risk), migration ML-DSA-65. Replaceable only upstream in helium-crypto/solana; observable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: curve25519-dalek 3.x is the curve arithmetic backend of ed25519-dalek 1.x (Ed25519 signatures); the in-tree X25519/key-agreement use is nil (no x25519/ECDH calls in workspace code; helium-lib/Cargo.toml:22 has only a commented-out curve25519-dalek line). Ships as the signature backend, not as a key-agreement primitive, in this tree.

properties.value: Dependency inventory: blake3@1.8.3 present in Cargo.lock; no blake3 call site in workspace code (transitive, Solana/anchor stack — solana uses blake3 for program hashing). No first-party use; reachable via dependencies. Changeable only upstream; observable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Sharded-wallet KDF combine step: after the password is stretched by PBKDF2/Argon2id and the Shamir-shared 32-byte SSS key is reconstructed (format.rs:144/:161), the final wallet encryption key = HMAC-SHA256(sss_key, stretched_password_hash). format.rs:169-174. Sound construction (keyed MAC as KDF combiner); not Shor-relevant. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Wallet data-at-rest: the Ed25519 (default) keypair is serialized and encrypted with AES-256-GCM (aes-gcm crate), 12-byte IV from sodiumoxide randombytes (wallet.rs:57), public-key bytes as AAD (wallet.rs:62), tag stored alongside. Key is the password-derived KEK (PBKDF2 1M or Argon2id13). Wallet files on disk stay readable only under AES-GCM; not Shor-relevant but defines the at-rest posture. Changeable here.

properties.value: Wallet keypair generation: helium_crypto::Keypair::generate with rand::rngs::OsRng, key_tag MainNet + type from CLI (default Ed25519, optional secp256k1/ecc_compact).
